workingTitle: A star spent seven years spiraling inside its giant companion
coreFacts: AT 2025abao, nicknamed Bao, is in the Andromeda Galaxy.
The observations are best explained by a roughly 0.7-solar-mass companion spiraling inside the envelope of a roughly 7-solar-mass aging giant.
The slow inspiral powered about seven years of gradual brightening before a late-2025 eruption.
The inferred merger ejected roughly 0.1 to 0.2 solar masses of material.
caveats: The merger and stellar parameters are physical inferences from multiwavelength observations and modeling, not direct imaging of two resolved stars.
A Nature press summary notes that future observations are needed to confirm conclusively that the two stars merged.
